set.body: Add sparse finite Relation with identity, composition, converse, union, image, erosion, and validated reflexive or symmetric evidence. Reuse graph.VertexBasis as the keyed metadata axis and add explicit graph adapters without weakening the loop-free simple-graph contract. Acceptance follows phase 2 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md and includes category, dagger, distributivity, adjunction, dense-reference, loop-policy, JVM, and Scala.js tests.
set.title: Locus 2: relation calculus and graph interop
